description: This file defines a module for fetching feature usage statistics from a backend API. It includes a helper to normalize date inputs and an exported async function 'fetchFeaturesUsage' that constructs query parameters, calls an analytics API endpoint, and processes the response to return sorted lists of most and least used features based on provided or default date ranges and filters.

methods.name: toIsoOrUndefined(dateLike)
methods.description: Helper function to convert a date-like input into an ISO string or return undefined if invalid.

methods.name: fetchFeaturesUsage({ from, to, tenant_id, user_id, limit = 8, serviceType } = {})
methods.description: Fetches and processes feature usage data from the backend, sorting by usage counts and returning objects representing most and least used features.

ctags.name: fetchFeaturesUsage
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchFeaturesUsage({ from, to, tenant_id, user_id, limit = 8, serviceType /
ctags.signature: ({ from, to, tenant_id, user_id, limit = 8, serviceType } = {})
